parameters.name: search_products
parameters.description: Find Vaigai products and exact prices. Input: plain text such as "ghee", "something for kids" or "curd for idli". Returns SKUs, names, units and prices. Always use this before stating a price.

parameters.name: delivery_check
parameters.description: Check whether a Madurai area or 6-digit pincode is on the delivery route. Input: the area name or pincode as text. Always use before promising delivery.

parameters.name: plan_calculator
parameters.description: Estimate the monthly cost of a daily or weekly plan. Input: JSON like {"sku":"VGM-CURD-400g","qty":1,"frequency":"daily"}. Use exact SKUs from search_products.

parameters.name: faq_lookup
parameters.description: Look up policies and quality answers (delivery time, pasteurisation, glass bottles, ordering, bulk). Input: the customer question as text.

parameters.name: store_info
parameters.description: Get opening hours, delivery promise, payment method and contact options. Input: any text.
parameters.jsCode: return JSON.stringify({brand:'Vaigai Milk',city:'Madurai, Tamil Nadu',delivery:'daily by 5:30 AM',orders:'6 AM to 9 PM',payment:'on delivery or confirmed by the team on WhatsApp',contact:'WhatsApp or the phone number in the website footer',languages:['English','Tamil']});

parameters.content:
AI ASSISTANT
1. Add your OpenAI credential to 'OpenAI Chat Model' (or swap in an Anthropic / Gemini chat model node).
2. Set the values in the Config node (webhook key, Google Sheet ID, WhatsApp and Telegram details). The website sends the same key in the x-vaigai-key header. Credentials: Google Sheets OAuth2, Telegram, OpenAI (assistant only). Nodes marked optional are disabled until you add credentials.
3. Activate the workflow and copy the Production URL into the website: assistantWebhook.

The agent only READS facts through tools and returns a validated JSON reply. Side effects (orders, leads) happen in the website and in workflows 02 and 04, so a prompt-injection can never place an order.
